description.narrative: The objective of the project is to support the rehabilitation of the water supply network in Yerevan. This will allow the Company to reduce technical water losses and improve water and waste water services, helping it to fulfil its commitments according to the lease agreement under which it operates with Veolia. The Project will also support investments in new water meters and reduce economic water losses.

description.narrative: Rehabilitation of water network infrastructure in Yerevan City
Installation of buster pumps

comment.narrative: Target has been achieved

The Final Report of the intervention covering period up to 31 October 2021 under Section 3.4 on pages 15 and 16 indicates that the contract for installation of booster pumps was successfully completed as of 4 July 2016. It is further stated under Section 4.2 on page 31 of the Final Report that The works in the frame of the Contract are finalized. All new installed Booster pumps are in operation. Following this the Final Report also provides a table listing the sites and technical parameters of all these 30 booster pumps.
